Title: Krystal Spyers Report 1
Description: Krystal Spyers and her news crew arrive at the 5 Coy compound amid rumours of plague, film the marines fighting the Brotherhood, and are ordered off the base by Lt Gill.

Title: Krystal Spyers Report 2
Description: Outside the compound gate the crew questions the marines about the plague and a withdrawn company doctor, and is roughly moved on again while a marine is treated.

Title: Krystal Spyers Report 4
Description: A short report from Altair IV, with a compound guard in the background.

Title: Krystal Spyers Report 5
Description: Krystal Spyers mocks the observation skills of the marines on guard duty, who take a while to spot the news crew.

Title: Krystal Spyers Report 6
Description: At the compound gate, the marines start to go down with the plague as the crew films.

Title: Krystal Spyers Report 7
Description: Piece to camera outside the building where the gang that took the plague cure is due to meet buyers; the cure was dropped to the marines the night before and lost.

Title: Krystal Spyers Report 8
Description: 5 Coy arrive at the rendezvous for the cure and intercept the news crew as the deal goes wrong.

Title: Krystal Spyers Report 9
Description: The marines surround the crew, an officer is challenged over the failed deal, and the crew's security man refuses to hand over his weapon. It doesn't end well.

Title: Krystal Spyers Report 10
Description: With her cameraman reported dead, Krystal Spyers talks over a remote feed as 5 Coy administer the cure, and blames the medic, Sgt Miracle, for getting the dose count wrong.

Title: Krystal Spyers Report 11
Description: A last piece to camera as the marines prepare to board the dropship: anyone not cured stays behind rather than risk contaminating the ship.

Title: Marine Assault
Description: 5 Coy assault a building and find a very dead body.

Title: Cure Negotiation - Part 1
Description: 5 Coy negotiate for the return of the plague cure.

Title: Cure Negotiation - Part 2
YouTubeTitle: Altair IV - Marine cure negotiation - Part 2.wmv
Description: Haggling over the price of the cure (32 credits against 10,000), then a vehicle tries to leave and the stand-off turns into a hostage situation.

Title: 5 Coy Prepare to Leave the Planet
YouTubeTitle: Altair IV - 5th Coy prepare to leave the planet.wmv
Description: The marines form up, with a rear guard, to board the dropship off Altair IV.

Title: 5 Coy Come Under Fire Boarding the Dropship
YouTubeTitle: Altair IV - 5th Coy come under fire boarding the dropship, and finally bug out.wmv
Description: Fired on while boarding, the marines push the attackers back before the dropship lifts off from Altair IV for the last time.

Title: Celestial News Network - Marie Celesta Special (Excerpt)
YouTubeTitle: Celestial News Network - Marie Celesta Special (Excerpt)
Description: Cut-down CNN special on the loss, discovery and destruction of the Marie Celesta, made after the event and built around the Garavaglia II's flight recorder.
